startNote: Elected in the June 2, 1998 District 5 special election; the Board approved the canvassing certificate (file 981791) on 1998-06-16, his first meeting in the minutes. No oath record online.
endNote: Last meeting in the minutes 2018-03-21; District 5 is listed vacant from the 2018-04-04 special meeting, which called the special election to fill it (R-290-18). 2018-03-31 is the resignation date in careers.jsonl; the minutes confirm only that he left between 2018-03-21 and 2018-04-04.
giftsNote: One cycle before the 1998 start. VoterFocus has county reports only from the 2002 cycle on, so gifts are covered from 2002-01-16; the 1998 special and 2000 campaigns are not online.

startNote: Won the 2011-06-28 special runoff; canvassing certificate (file 111508) accepted 2011-07-19; first BCC meeting as mayor 2011-07-07. No oath record online; 2011-06-28 is the election date, not a sworn date.
endNote: Term ended when the next mayor took office 2020-11-17; last BCC meeting of his term 2020-11-16.
mayorFields: Each action in this window has a 'mayor' block with raw facts (cover memo From line and RECOMMENDATION text from the matter page, requester, sponsors, whether the title authorizes the Mayor to execute or ratifies his action, whether the Clerk's file type is 'Mayoral Veto') and, for vetoed files, 'veto.overrideVotes'. None of it is converted into a vote.
